description: Playwright browser_navigate changed the shell working directory to .playwright-mcp/ and never restored it. Subsequent Bash tool calls resolved paths against the wrong directory, breaking hook lookups (eval-turn-start.py not found) and any other IES-root-relative operations.
reproduction: mcp__playwright__browser_navigate followed by Bash commands that rely on CWD being the IES root. The .playwright-mcp/ subdirectory became the active CWD after navigation, causing hooks and scripts to fail with ENOENT.
hook_error: UserPromptSubmit blocked: python3 '.claude/hooks/eval-turn-start.py' resolved against /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/.playwright-mcp/ instead of IES root
proposed_fix: After any Playwright tool call, immediately run an explicit `cd {IES_ROOT}` Bash command to restore the working directory. Alternatively, always use absolute paths in Bash commands following Playwright calls. Add a standing rule: after mcp__playwright__browser_* calls, restore CWD before the next Bash tool use.
systemic_rule: After any mcp__playwright__browser_* call, restore working directory with `cd /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES` before the next Bash tool call. Never assume CWD survived a Playwright navigation.
